runWorkflow.reason: Bounded mode calls MutateWorkflowRun with the one literal callback, aggregate, event type and payload that the off branch passes to MutateWorkspace (SW503 AST guard); the off branch is byte-for-byte the pre-P21 code. SW500 compares the actual runWorkflow outcome, run, error class, SQL issue/content/metadata rows, root, events, webhooks and realtime against legacy on bounded warm and SQL-reloaded sources for every action type (notify default/explicit, assignIssue, setIssuePriority, addIssueLabel plain/grouped/already present, createIssue, unknown types, no actions, all seven in one run, detached pointer after prepend), every action failure postimage (missing/former recipient and creator, missing/former assignee, no/missing/non-issue resource, out-of-range/non-numeric priority, missing/archived/archived-group/missing-group/project labels, missing team, blank title, no default state), retry history (backoff, capped backoff, max attempts reached/zero, manual retry of a not-yet-due run, retry after success, due retry superseded by success, duplicate run IDs, 499/500-run tails dropping the cleared predecessor), consecutive error reset/increment, manual/schedule/retry/issueCreated triggers on enabled and disabled definitions, missing definitions, every schedule rule (@hourly/@daily/@weekly, weekday and Sunday cron, steps, ranges/lists, invalid and sub-minute rules), 4 MiB issue descriptions with all actions, 4 MiB unrelated issues on create, 4 MiB definition rows and retained predecessors, and peer-replica writes (rescheduled/claimed retries and schedules, renamed/deleted definitions, issue title and same-field priority, appended runs) merged or refreshed and retried. Root gate (pinned, not certified): a definition over about 4 MiB exceeds the shared aggregate-plan envelope (sixteen copies of both definition images) and is refused atomically where the literal writer succeeds; 3 MiB definitions are certified. SW502 cancels at sampled SQL statements and requires the untouched preimage or the exact literal postimage with no leaked work. SW201 and SW322 (principal/key matrix) remain.
